system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes reclining on a sofa in a purple dressing-gown, pipe-rack within reach at his right, turning his attention toward the chair beside him","action":"Holmes lounges back against the cushions, lens and forceps resting on the chair seat, his gaze fixed on the battered hat hanging from the chair back","setting":"Baker Street sitting-room, gas lamps and coal fire, frost-covered windows with ice crystals, a wooden chair by the sofa","secondaryElements":"Crumpled morning papers scattered near the couch; pipe-rack on the table; Dr. Watson framed in the doorway in frock-coat and top hat, visitor's presence implied","mood":"Dry, restrained, curious and gaslit intimate, with a faint comic air","timeOfDay":"Morning, second day after Christmas, dim grey winter light","composition":"Interior medium shot from the doorway, Holmes on the sofa at left, the chair and hat centred in the frame, frosted window light at right"}
